name: 微信小程序自动化
description: Control WeChat DevTools to run, inspect, screenshot and debug mini programs.
description_zh: 连接本机微信开发者工具，自动完成小程序调试：读取页面数据、执行 JS、点击与输入、模拟器截图、查看 console 与网络日志。
description_en: Connect to local WeChat DevTools and automate mini program debugging: read page data, execute JavaScript, tap and type, screenshot the simulator, and inspect console and network logs.
examples_zh: 连上微信开发者工具，把当前页面截图给我看看
读一下现在这个页面的 data，告诉我有哪些字段
看看模拟器 console 里有没有报错
打开订单页，点击提交按钮，再把结果截图给我
examples_en: Connect to WeChat DevTools and screenshot the current page
Read the current page data and list its fields
Check the simulator console for errors
Open the order page, tap submit, then screenshot the result
